sources.snippet: Model: π0.5 — a 3B flow-matching VLA with a PaliGemma-2B backbone and a 300M action expert. Fine-tuning: LoRA adapters injected into both modules: PaliGemma backbone: LoRA rank=16 Action expert: LoRA rank=32 Training: batch size=64, 30k steps, cosine decay (peak lr=5e-5), A100×1 (~58 hours). Framework: openpi (JAX).
